_doc: Field registry for 100% byte accounting. kind: field|const|magic|checksum|pad|volatile|unknown. val (validation tag): WP=watchpoint/breakpoint-confirmed | CAP=live-capture (RAM read / before-after at live base) | DIFF=cohort byte-diff | DISASM=disassembly-only | SINGLE=single populated sample (mid_campaign) | INFER=structural inference (not cohort-observed) | STRUCT=structural const/pad. Offsets are within each block plaintext (header = unencrypted 0x80). Each block tiles 0..size-1 with no gaps/overlaps; gaps filled with kind:unknown runs. The campaign block also carries tag (A = read in the code, B = observed in the emulator or a save sample, C = a guess; A/B = code + observed, A/C = located in code, meaning guessed; from sgst-port docs/modding/campaign-save.md) and type (s8/s16/u32/..., little-endian). A repeated structure is one entry with record = {count, stride, fields}: record i starts at off + i*stride and its fields (offsets relative to the record) tile 0..stride-1. See SAVE_FIELD_MAP.md for full prose, the WRITER table, and OPEN ITEMS.
